per_advertiser.description: Holds whose `status` is `held` for one advertiser, counted by the `commitment.advertisers[]` in each hold's `requested_terms`. A hold that names several advertisers counts once for each

per_buyer.description: Holds whose `status` is `held` on proposals issued to one `buyer.domain`
